## FAQ – Ashcombe Bay Tee (White, Crest Design)

| Question | Answer |
|----------|--------|
| **What is the Ashcombe Bay tee made of?** | 100 % combed, ring‑spun cotton – soft, breathable, and durable. |
| **What sizes are available?** | S, M, L, XL, XXL, 3XL. All come in a true‑to‑size fit. |
| **Is this tee machine washable?** | Yes. Wash cold, inside‑out, and tumble dry low for best longevity. |
| **Can I use bleach or harsh detergents?** | Avoid bleach and heavy‑duty detergents; they can fade the crest. |
| **Will the crest fade or crack after washing?** | The crest is screen‑printed and set in a pre‑treated canvas, so it stays crisp for years with normal care. |
| **Is the tee true‑to‑size?** | It runs slightly smaller in the chest; we recommend sizing up for a relaxed look. |
| **Do you offer customized size or color variants?** | Currently only the white base with the standard crest. Custom requests can be submitted to our support team. |
| **What’s the return policy?** | 30‑day, no‑questions‑asked return. The item must be unworn, unwashed, and in its original packaging. |
| **How long does shipping take?** | 3‑5 business days within the U.S. (tracking included). International shipping is 10‑15 business days. |
| **Do you honor size exchanges on exchanges‑only orders?** | Yes – we’ll ship a replacement size at no extra cost; just email us for the new size. |
| **Can I track my order?** | Once your order ships, a tracking link will be emailed to you. |
| **What if the crest is damaged upon arrival?** | Contact us within 48 h and we’ll send a replacement or offer a refund. |
| **Do you offer bulk or wholesale purchasing?** | Yes! Email wholesale@ourshop.com for bulk pricing and MOQ details. |

Feel free to copy this table into your shop page. If you’d like a slightly longer explanation for any question, just let me know!
